results.question: Floor 6 normal branch panel goes dark. Impact?
results.answer: The floor‑6 normal branch panel failure knocks out power to SURG and ORTHO, affecting 27 beds (15 SURG, 12 ORTHO) and 22 patients (12 SURG, 10 ORTHO) [PNL-6N]. All 116 assets in those wards lose power, with 60 on battery for up to 60 minutes [PNL-6N]. Critical substitutes needed are crash carts (1 each in SURG and ORTHO) and additional SCD pumps and wheelchairs, which can be sourced from nearby wards [PNL-6N].
